cases.input: Generate a provider-neutral graph from three structured knowledge artifacts and two explicit typed links, then hand it to a renderer.
requiredBehaviors: reuse artifact IDs as node identities
create edges only from explicit or producer-confirmed relations
forbiddenBehaviors: invent a relation because two artifacts look related
make renderer layout fields part of canonical semantics
skillAnchors: Übernimm nur explizite oder vom fachlichen Producer bestätigte Relationen

cases.input: Generate a graph with one explicit unresolved conflicting relation and one external target that is intentionally not present in the local snapshot.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the unresolved/conflicting relation state instead of flattening it
allow the missing target only when explicitly represented as external
forbiddenBehaviors: turn the conflict into a normal definitive edge
silently create a local node for an unloaded external target
skillAnchors: Markiere unresolved/conflicting Relationen statt sie zu glätten
außer sie sind explizit als externe Targets markiert

cases.input: A graph draft adds an inferred dependency edge, drops sourceRefs, and changes relation types while converting to JSON Canvas for nicer visualization.
requiredBehaviors: require relation types to survive rendering round-trip
forbiddenBehaviors: allow a renderer to change domain semantics
skillAnchors: Darstellungsattribute dürfen die fachliche Semantik nicht verändern
